newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firm, cargo trades at five year highs.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firm, cargo trades at five year highs.

text.p: NWE naphtha was firmer again on Monday amid tight supply, traders said.
A trader was heard buying an Egyptian cargo, loading at the end of the month, at $216 cif NWE. This was the highest level seen since the Gulf war.
Oct naphtha swaps were talked mostly near $206/$209 cif NWE and gasoline barges traded at just $200 fob ARA.
Premiums for full-range naphtha remain notionally at around $3 over quoted high cif numbers in northwest Europe and the Med.
Small Russian pieces were still available.
